# Package `audit/anchorobj`

Go module `github.com/bide-ai/bide`; [all packages](index.md).

`github.com/bide-ai/bide/audit/anchorobj` · [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bide-ai/bide/audit/anchorobj) · Stability: **experimental**

Package anchorobj is the part of an object-store audit anchor that does not depend on any storage SDK: the layout of the objects that hold signed tree heads, their canonical body, the checks a Reader makes on an object it reads back, the equivocation check, and the tripwire for run IDs that look like personal data.

**Constants**

- `const SizeDigits = 19`: SizeDigits is the width of the inverted size in an object name.
- `const DigestHex = 32`: DigestHex is the length of the digest in an object name, in hex digits.
- `const ObjectSuffix = ".json"`: ObjectSuffix ends every object name.
- `const PartitionLen = 64`: PartitionLen is the length of a partition name (a hex SHA-256).

**Functions**

- `func CheckEquivocation(heads []audit.SignedTreeHead, errEquivocation error) error`: CheckEquivocation returns an error wrapping errEquivocation when two heads of one tree and size commit to different roots: the log key signed two histories.
- `func InvertedSize(size int) string`: InvertedSize is the sortable, fixed-width form of a head size: larger sizes sort first.
- `func ObjectName(size int, body []byte) string`: ObjectName is the name of a body within its partition: inverted size, then its digest.
- `func SplitKey(prefix, key string) (partition, name string, ok bool)`: SplitKey splits a key under prefix into its partition and name.
- `func SuspectID(id string) string`: SuspectID returns a reason when a run or trail ID looks like it holds personal data, or "".

## type Layout

```go
type Layout struct {

	PartitionTag string

}
```

Layout is one backend's naming and encoding of anchored heads.

**Methods**

- `func (l Layout) Decode(partition, name string, body []byte, v audit.Verifier) (audit.SignedTreeHead, error)`: Decode checks that body is the object the key names (partition and name) and returns its head.
- `func (l Layout) Encode(sth audit.SignedTreeHead) ([]byte, error)`: Encode is the body of the object that anchors sth.
- `func (l Layout) Key(prefix, kind, runID string, size int, body []byte) string`: Key is the full key of a body for a head of the given kind, run and size.
- `func (l Layout) Partition(kind, runID string) string`: Partition is the partition name of a tree kind and run ID.
